description: This Java class, LoanApplicationTestBuilder, provides a builder pattern to construct loan application request payloads for integration testing in the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates various loan parameters and configurations, allowing flexible creation of complex loan application data in JSON format.

classes.name: LoanApplicationTestBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate creation of loan application request data with various configurable parameters for testing purposes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Generates the JSON string representing the loan application data based on the configured parameters, optionally with client and loan product IDs.

methods.name: withExternalId
methods.description: Sets an external identifier for the loan application.

methods.name: withPrincipal
methods.description: Sets the principal amount for the loan.

methods.name: withLoanTermFrequency
methods.description: Sets the loan term duration.

methods.name: withLoanTermFrequencyAsDays
methods.description: Sets the loan term frequency type to days.

methods.name: withLinkedAccount
methods.description: Associates a linked account ID, typically for savings or other financial accounts.

methods.name: withLoanTermFrequencyAsMonths
methods.description: Sets the loan term frequency type to months.

methods.name: withLoanTermFrequencyAsWeeks
methods.description: Sets the loan term frequency type to weeks.

methods.name: withLoanTermFrequencyAsYears
methods.description: Sets the loan term frequency type to years.

methods.name: withNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Specifies the number of repayments for the loan.

methods.name: withRepaymentEveryAfter
methods.description: Sets the repayment interval period.

methods.name: withRepaymentFrequencyTypeAsDays
methods.description: Sets the repayment frequency type to days.

methods.name: withRepaymentFrequencyTypeAsMonths
methods.description: Sets the repayment frequency type to months.

methods.name: withRepaymentFrequencyTypeAsWeeks
methods.description: Sets the repayment frequency type to weeks.

methods.name: withRepaymentFrequencyTypeAsYear
methods.description: Sets the repayment frequency type to years.

methods.name: withInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Sets the interest rate per period.

methods.name: withInterestTypeAsFlatBalance
methods.description: Configures interest type as flat balance.

methods.name: withInterestTypeAsDecliningBalance
methods.description: Configures interest type as declining balance.

methods.name: withAmortizationTypeAsEqualInstallments
methods.description: Configures amortization type as equal installments.

methods.name: withAmortizationTypeAsEqualPrincipalPayments
methods.description: Configures amortization type as equal principal payments.

methods.name: withInterestCalculationPeriodTypeSameAsRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Sets interest calculation period type to be the same as repayment period.

methods.name: withInterestCalculationPeriodTypeAsDays
methods.description: Sets interest calculation period type to days.

methods.name: withExpectedDisbursementDate
methods.description: Sets the expected disbursement date.

methods.name: withSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the loan application was submitted.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Associates charges with the loan application.

methods.name: withCollaterals
methods.description: Associates collateral items with the loan application.

methods.name: withLoanType
methods.description: Specifies the type of loan (e.g., individual, group, glim).

methods.name: withtotalLoan
methods.description: Sets total loan amount.

methods.name: withPrincipalGrace
methods.description: Configures grace period on principal payment.

methods.name: withInterestGrace
methods.description: Configures grace period on interest payment.

methods.name: withTranches
methods.description: Defines disbursement tranches.

methods.name: withRepaymentStrategy
methods.description: Sets the repayment strategy code.

methods.name: withLoanScheduleProcessingType
methods.description: Configures the loan schedule processing type.

methods.name: withFirstRepaymentDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for repayments.

methods.name: withParentAccount
methods.description: Designates if the loan is a parent account.

methods.name: withApprovalFormData
methods.description: Sets additional approval form data.

methods.name: withCalendarID
methods.description: Associates a calendar ID for syncing disbursements and repayments.

methods.name: withSyncDisbursementWithMeetin
methods.description: Enables synchronization of disbursement with group meetings.

methods.name: withFixedEmiAmount
methods.description: Sets fixed EMI amount for repayment schedule.

methods.name: withDatatables
methods.description: Associates data tables with the loan application.

methods.name: withPrinciplePercentagePerInstallment
methods.description: Sets the percentage of principal per installment.

methods.name: withinterestChargedFromDate
methods.description: Sets the date from which interest is charged.

methods.name: withInArrearsTolerance
methods.description: Sets the in-arrears tolerance amount.

methods.name: withCreateStandingInstructionAtDisbursement
methods.description: Configures creation of standing instructions at disbursement.

methods.name: withEnableDownPayment
methods.description: Enables down payment options.

methods.name: withEnableAutoRepaymentForDownPayment
methods.description: Enables auto repayment for down payment.

methods.name: withDisbursedAmountPercentageDownPayment
methods.description: Sets percentage for disbursed amount as down payment.
